title: Entry — Scored Application
what: Apply with a scored file worth 10 marks: motivation statement (5) + SEE for Seniors / last final exam for Juniors (5). The only Nepali olympiad where the application itself is graded.
facts: Registration NRs 1,000 (non-refundable); 50% waiver with a local-government letter
Documents: application form, marksheet, character certificate, birth certificate, payment slip
outcome: Application scored; eligible for the Provincial Round

title: Provincial Round
what: Two-hour entrance exam at 7 provincial centres: 30 MCQ × 2 + 3 long questions × 10 = 90 marks, plus your 10 application marks.
facts: Subjective and objective questions from the official syllabus

title: National Round
what: Assignments, projects and basic data-analysis tasks. Small reports; simple observational tools such as paper telescopes.
facts: Emphasis on understanding, originality and clarity rather than competition
outcome: Assessed; ready for the closed camp

title: Final Round — Closed Camp
what: Seven-day national closed camp in Kathmandu: theoretical tests, data analysis and observational astronomy (often paper-based), following the IOAA syllabus structure.
facts: Lectures: stellar physics, celestial mechanics, coordinate systems, data processing
outcome: Trained on the IOAA syllabus; mock exams completed

title: National Merit List
what: Merit lists of 40 students each (Senior and Junior) are published.

title: Delegation Selection
what: Selection for IOAA, IOAA-jr, IAO, OWAO and APAO as per the invitations received — based on merit plus interviews with students and their parents.
facts: Five international contests: IOAA · IAO · IOAA-jr · OWAO · APAO

title: Pre-departure Training
what: Hybrid training covering advanced problem-solving in theoretical and observational astronomy, data analysis, telescope handling and the practical skills needed to compete.
facts: NAO2026: online orientation 31 July; structured training from 6 August, running in phases until each team departs

actions.label: Practical handouts by a Nepal IOAA 2025 team member

title: International Olympiads
what: Represent Nepal. The IOAA is 600 marks: 300 theory + 300 practical (Data Analysis 150 · Telescope 50 · Sky Map 50 · Planetarium 50).
facts: Nepal since 2014: 3 bronze (IAO) · 5 HM · 1 special award
Nepal hosted IOAA-jr 2024 in Kathmandu — the first international olympiad hosted by Nepal
